shortBulletSummary: Middle East tensions trigger crypto market pullback and renew inflation fears.
President Trump is set to approve the final text of the CLARITY Act, aiming to clarify US crypto regulation.
Bitcoin consolidates near $64,000 while Ethereum drops and ETF inflows show mixed signals.
UK finalizes its crypto regulatory framework, while US and UK Treasuries push for stablecoin clarity.
US economic data dampens expectations for immediate Fed rate cuts, with a stronger USD weighing on crypto.
